description: TP-Link Account Level Open API examples, copied from the public 'Open API Access Guide' (omada-northbound-docs-beta.tplinkcloud.com, account-level-access-guide, read 2026-10-07) and the two live answers recorded in autoclaude/processed/10-tplink-cloud-controllers.md (EUW, dummy credentials, 2026-10-07). Used by the cloud unit tests (CloudAccountClient, the Open API cloud route, CloudAccessService). No test sends anything to a tplinkcloud.com host: the fake transport serves these bodies.
